facts.fact: Felix 拆穿她的「我就看看」：她要评估其他盾卫者，看有没有可学的
facts.anchor: She wants to evaluate the other Shielders. See if they’re better than her.

facts.fact: Larissa 以「意外」为名放箭雨偷袭，被她及时盾挡
facts.anchor: The arrows hurtling towards them smashed against her impeccably timed shield

facts.fact: 被辱「你们边境人就是蠢」后黑暗之声再度诱惑她杀掉 Larissa；她靠母亲的告诫压下
facts.anchor: Kill her, the Dark Voice taunted in Inara’s head.

facts.fact: Na-Ri 生于边境、 Trials 垫底，为留在 Larissa 圈子里只能任其羞辱
facts.anchor: If she wishes to remain in Larissa’s inner circle, she must.

facts.fact: 高议会不许 Chosen 参加 Shielder Trials（公主转述规定）
facts.anchor: The High Council will not permit a Chosen to participate in The Shielder Trials.

facts.fact: 公主点破两难：Chosen 可从守护兽借力=不公平优势，赢了也会被议论
facts.anchor: Chosen are able to draw power from their Guardian.

facts.fact: Kronan 出主意：找 Brander Melaine 做临时无效化链结的印记
facts.anchor: A Brander can imbue a brand to do whatever they desire, including nullifying a soul-link.

facts.fact: 她疑心被操纵陷入偏执，Felix 弹她鼻子一句话点醒（brands 非永久，值得试）
facts.anchor: “No. No, no, no.” Felix flicked her nose.
